label: Fretformer 2 Inpaint (ONNX)
note: Fretformer 2's Inpaint model: the same graph layout as Fretformer 2 (its own encoder, decoder and prefix tables) plus a fill-in-the-middle decoder that rewrites picked bars. It can also write whole charts.

demucs_analysis_stft.description: Demucs HTDemucs analysis STFT (Conv1d complex STFT). Reflect-padded stereo mix flattened to (2, padded_L) -> real/imag spectrograms. Byte-identical to the htdemucs graph (depends only on nfft/hop/window).

demucs_core_network.description: Demucs htdemucs_6s core network (manual-attention encoder/decoder + cross transformer), 6 sources: drums, bass, other, vocals, guitar, piano. Only numerically correct at the trace time axis.

demucs_synthesis_istft.description: Demucs HTDemucs synthesis ISTFT (ConvTranspose1d weighted overlap-add). Nyquist bin restored + 2-frame time pad before this graph. Byte-identical to the htdemucs graph.

beat_this_mel.description: Beat This log-mel spectrogram frontend (torchaudio MelSpectrogram n_fft=1024 hop=441 f_min=30 f_max=11000 n_mels=128 slaney power=1 normalized=frame_length + log1p(1000*m)). mono 22050 Hz wav -> [n_frames, 128] (time x bins).

beat_this_core.description: Fine-tuned Beat This core (val beat F=0.9082) beat+downbeat logit head, traced at chunk_size=1500 frames (50 fps). Only numerically valid at exactly 1500 frames.

transcriber_mel.description: Transcriber mel frontend (librosa-style log-mel dB, n_fft=2048 hop=512 n_mels=80 fmin=0 fmax=11025 slaney power=2 center=True pad_mode=constant absolute dB ref=1.0). mono 22050 Hz wav -> mel_db[80, n_frames] (bins x time). The graph outputs ABSOLUTE dB; the app-side shared-dB-reference + normalize steps (see stages.transcriber.sharedDbReference and normalizeMelDb) must be applied BEFORE beatMelWindows.

transcriber_encoder.description: Fretformer 2 encoder. Beat-mel [1,n_beats,6,80,32] (full, drums, bass, vocals, guitar, other) + mask [1,n_beats] -> cross-attention KV cache (cross_k/cross_v (10,8,n_beats,64)), aligned_memory (n_beats,512), mem_invalid (1,1,n_beats).

transcriber_decoder_step.description: Fretformer 2 single-step decoder (10 layers, 8 heads, head_dim=64, d_model=512, vocab=167). One autoregressive step: token_id+step_id+beat_idx -> logits + appended self-attention K/V cache row. Two-call CFG is the (parity-validated) naive orchestration; batched-CFG is a follow-up speed optimization.

transcriber_fim_decoder.description: Fill-in-the-middle decoder for Inpaint (vocab 170: FIM_SUF 167, FIM_MID 168, FIM_HOLE 169). n tokens per call on top of a past cache, causal inside the chunk; step_id must be the cache position (past + i). Serves chunked prefill, one-token sampling steps and teacher-forced seam scoring (every chunk position's logits). Batch fixed to 1. Export + parity (6.1e-5 max logit diff vs PyTorch single steps): training repo scripts/export_fim_decoder_onnx.py.

demucs.safety: The core network is only numerically correct at exactly 343980 samples / 336 frames. Assert the padded segment length equals 343980 before every core call; off-shape inference silently corrupts output.
demucs.accuracy: Validated against PyTorch htdemucs_6s apply_model(shifts=0, split=True, overlap=0.25) on two full songs: 72-85 dB SDR on audible stems, 73.3 dB mean over all 12 stems; the two sub-60 dB stems are near-silent (RMS <= 1.1e-3, max abs error <= 8.2e-5).

beat.safety: The beat core ONNX is only numerically valid at exactly 1500 mel frames. Assert the chunk mel length equals 1500 before every core call; off-shape inference silently corrupts output. The full split -> aggregate -> minimal postproc -> smoother chain mirrors upstream beat_this.inference.split_predict_aggregate + Postprocessor(type="minimal", fps=50) followed by the timing smoother.
beat.accuracy: Validated against the upstream Python library + reference smoother (same mel+core fp32 graphs, same mono 22050 Hz decoded wav; PASS bar: same beat/downbeat counts and max|Δ| ≤ 1e-3 s on raw + smoothed beats and downbeats).

transcriber.sharedDbReference: ref_db = max over the 6 input channels { max_{t,mel} mel_db_abs_c[t,mel] }; mel_db_shared_c = mel_db_abs_c - ref_db (training: scripts/build_demucs6_feature_cache.py, ref = max mel power over the six model channels)
transcriber.beatMelWindows: For each beat i in [0,n_beats): sample 32 points at t_i + (j+0.5)/32 * (t_{i+1}-t_i) for j in [0,32). Convert to fractional frame index = time / (512/22050); idx0=floor clipped to [0,n_frames-1]; idx1=idx0+1 clamped to [0,n_frames-1]; linearly interpolate out[m,j] = mel[m,idx0]*(1-frac) + mel[m,idx1]*frac. Result per channel: (80,32). Stack 6 channels -> (n_beats,6,80,32) -> (1,n_beats,6,80,32).
transcriber.nBeatsDetermination: From beatThis smoothed grid + nLeadIn prepended; n_beats = len(beatTimes)-1, capped so beatTimes[n_beats] <= audioDuration and to model_config.max_beats (1280).

prefixConditioning.loader: engine/lib/onnx/prefixTables.mjs (tiny pure-JS npz/npy reader; no Python at runtime)
prefixConditioning.lookupRule: For each knob k in [0,5): scan the first 8 prefix tokens for one in [DESC_BASE + k*8, DESC_BASE + k*8 + 8) (descriptorTokenBase = DESC_BASE = 110, as ChartTranscriber._descriptor_ids); if found, bin_id = tok - base, else bin_id = 7 (auto). prefix_bias += desc_tables[k][bin_id]. difficulty embedding is NOT applied (pervasive_difficulty=false).
prefixConditioning.condPrefixTokens: [BOS, difficulty_token(diff), descriptor_token(0, b0), ..., descriptor_token(4, b4), SOLO_FLAG, SECTION_FLAG_ON]  (len 9)
prefixConditioning.uncondPrefixTokens: [BOS, difficulty_token(diff), descriptor_token(0, 7), ..., descriptor_token(4, 7), SOLO_FLAG, SECTION_FLAG_ON]  (all-auto knobs, same structure flags as the conditional prefix; len 9).
prefixConditioning.note: CFG runs only when at least one knob is set: with every knob on Auto the conditional and unconditional prefixes are identical, so guidance would reproduce the unguided logits.

transcriber.safety: Encoder must receive beat_mel as NORMALIZED [-1,1] values (after shared-dB-reference subtraction + normalize_mel_db), NOT raw dB. The mel graph outputs ABSOLUTE dB; failing the shared reference or the normalize produces a constant affine offset per song that the encoder is NOT trained to tolerate. CFG MUST be the naive 2-call shape (cond + uncond, guided = uncond + w*(cond-uncond), then sample/argmax on guided) -- batched-CFG is NOT validated for parity.
transcriber.accuracy: Exported ONNX graphs validated token-identical to the reference implementation, with and without CFG.
transcriber.stemSource: htdemucs_6s float32 stems (piano summed into other at the waveform level) written as 44.1 kHz float WAVs, decoded with FFmpeg to 22050 Hz stereo, mono = mean(L,R); full mix decoded straight from the source at 22050 Hz.

decode.note: Sample only once the whole prefix has been fed, as ChartTranscriber.generate does. The v1 app loop also samples while feeding the prefix and appends those predictions after it.

structure.prefixFlags: After the five knob tokens: SOLO_FLAG_ON (the model may place a solo) or SOLO_FLAG_OFF (no solo markers), then SECTION_FLAG_ON. Both CFG streams carry the same flags.
structure.sectionFlag: Always ON. The OFF prefix was ~1% of training; it gives worse notes (onset -0.024, rhythm -0.031 on 40 held-out songs) and finds fewer solos.
structure.stream: Right after a BEAT, in this order: SOLO_END, SECTION_BASE+type, SOLO_START. They do not advance the beat clock. decodeStructure (chartEventStream.mjs) reads them; decodeTokens skips them.
structure.chartOutput: E solo / E soloend in the difficulty track at beat*resolution (E solo before that tick's notes, E soloend after); a solo that never ends runs to the last beat. Sections go in [Events] as E "section Chorus 2" (type 'other' -> 'Section').

fim.layout: header, beats before the hole, FIM_SUF, beats after the hole (each later hole one FIM_HOLE), FIM_MID, the hole's beats, EOS (training repo src/data/fim.py). Explicit per-token beat index: header 0, FIM_SUF the first beat after the hole (clamped to the last beat), FIM_HOLE / FIM_MID the hole's first beat, hole tokens their own beat.
fim.decode: The hole's first BEAT is teacher-forced after FIM_MID. Sampling masks PAD, BOS and the FIM tokens; inside the hole EOS is masked until the hole's beats are all out, then BEAT is masked (n_beats = hole length). Holes fill left to right, each on the chart with the earlier fills in it.
fim.markers: Kept: the chart's own solo/section markers for each hole beat are teacher-forced right after its BEAT, and sampled marker tokens are masked, so Inpaint never moves a solo or section.
fim.rerank: Best of `candidates` by the mean normal-order log-prob of the chart's next `seamBeats` beats after the hole, teacher-forced after the candidate (training repo eval_inpainting_continuation.py seam_lp_of). A hole that runs to the song's end keeps candidate 0.

transcriber_reference_manifest.note: Exporter manifest kept alongside the graphs as transcriber_manifest.json; any model_config / vocab / prefix_conditioning / structure change here must stay in sync.
